decisions.reason: Product A closely extends the firm's existing vessel-management knowledge and offshore strategic focus, giving strong absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve the service.
Product B builds directly on the firm's established crew and travel administration, allowing effective assimilation of feedback and continuous improvement through related expertise.
Product C leverages the firm's vessel information domain and can benefit from cooperation with research institutions, supporting absorptive capacity despite the digital component.
Product D is related to vessel performance and draws on existing maritime knowledge, but its mobile-app delivery requires complementary software skills that the firm can acquire through partnerships.
